title: gravity_complementary: default k=0.995 and validate gyro shape, dtype and units
problem: orientation.py:21 defaults k=0.98, i.e. 2% accelerometer weight per sample (0.5 s time constant), so with no rotation the fused estimate is NOISIER than gravity_lowpass: 0.83 vs 0.43 deg (walk), 0.59 vs 0.31 deg (run). With k=0.995 it is 0.23/0.17 deg with no swing and 0.23/0.20 deg under a 30 deg arm swing, where the lowpass is 18.6/18.7 deg off. ```
def count_steps(acc, hop_s=0.2):
    """Offline twin of server.state() (after T12: server._count_locked()); keep the two in sync.
    acc: (N,3) phone-frame acceleration, m/s^2 or g. Returns (count, states) where states is the
    classify() label of every 2 s window stepped by hop_s."""
    acc = np.asarray(acc, float)
    if len(acc) < 3 * FS:
        return 0, []
    if np.median(np.linalg.norm(acc, axis=1)) < 3:   # phone sent g units, mirror server.py:39-40
        acc = acc * 9.81
    g = gravity_lowpass(acc)
    v, h, _ = vertical_horizontal(acc, g)
    hop = int(hop_s * FS)
    count, last, states = 0, -10 ** 9, []
    for end in range(3 * FS, len(v) + 1, hop):
        w = slice(end - 2 * FS, end)
        feat = features(v[w], h[w])          # keep feat: T31 reads feat['cadence_hz'] here
        st = classify(feat)
        states.append(st)
        lo = max(0, end - 4 * FS)
        for p in detect_steps(v[lo:end], st):
            gi = lo + p
            if gi > last + 0.25 * FS and gi < end - 0.2 * FS:

    return count, states
